processing.aggregation: sum of provided integer counts across all cells of each cell type
processing.X: natural log1p of counts normalized to target_sum over the supplied gene subset
processing.normalization_background: provided genes only; full-transcriptome library totals are unavailable
processing.replication: one pooled profile per cell type; donor variation is not modeled
processing.organism_tissue: human heart inferred from source gene IDs and supplied cell annotations
processing.input_assumption: X contains counts; integer values verified, assay provenance was not supplied

source_citation: not supplied; original cell annotations were retained in aggregate form
